call_points.text: Management aspires to about 20% growth in FY27 and FY28 but declined to give a specific FY27 number.
The peptide plant will be commissioned next month, with multiple projects lined up at various stages.
Commercial CMS growth is driven by about three molecules, with one more commercialisation expected this year.
Working capital days improved to 84 from 137 at FY26 end.
Strategic collaboration with Gland Pharma for sterile APIs is asset-light and covers niche generic products.
Management sees no destocking risk and says order visibility is consistent with its commentary.
Stock split or bonus is a board matter; management will discuss it but gave no timeline.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Disputed Income Tax Liability for Assessment Year 2004-05 : The Income tax authorities had re-opened the income tax assessment of the Company for the assessment year 2004- 05 later than the periods permitted by the provisions of the Income Tax Act, 1961 and thereby demanded an additional tax amount of Rs. 693.33 lacs on account of disallowance of certain prior period expenditure recognized by the Company in the computation of gross total income for the assessment year then ended. Aggrieved by the order of the Income Tax department, the management had filed an appeal with the higher authorities which had been successfully decided in favour of the Company. The Income Tax department has however filed an appeal with the Hon’ble High Court of Telangana in this regard, which is pending final outcome.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: The Principal Commissioner of Income Tax, Hyderabad (Income Tax Department
tax_litigation.status: The hearing was initially scheduled for 9th July 2025 which was subsequently postponed to a later date.

operating_notes.text: Unit 1 at Bonthapally had 256 KL capacity running at 91% utilisation before the approved 120.5 KL addition.
US and North America revenue was ₹313.66 Cr in Q4FY26 against ₹99.63 Cr a year earlier; Europe ₹296.61 Cr against ₹94.96 Cr.
Commercial CMS projects contributed over two-thirds of revenue in Q4 FY26.
Commercial CMS growth is driven by about three molecules, with one more commercialisation expected this year and one or two next year.
Peptide plant is to be commissioned next month and is located in an FDA-approved site but will be subject to a future FDA audit.
Working capital days improved to 84 in Q1FY27 from 137 at FY26 end.
US FDA issued an EIR and closed its 10-14 August 2026 inspection of the Unit 3 plant at Gaddapotharam village, Jinnaram, Sangareddy District.

Neuland Laboratories hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call, reporting total income of ₹788.7 Cr and PAT of ₹212.5 Cr.
